title: Tunisian Phyllo Triangles
description: A crispy and savory pastry filled with the flavors of Tunisia. Enjoy as a snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: tunisian light
ingredients.notes: a mix of olive oil, garlic, and spices

ingredients.name: heavenly
ingredients.notes: a mix of chopped olives, capers, and parsley

instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to package instructions.
Cut the phyllo dough into 4-inch squares.
Brush each square with tunisian light, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Place a small spoonful of heavenly in the center of each square.
Fold the dough into triangles by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Brush the tops of the triangles with tunisian light.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
